scope: All copies acquired or generated for this project's medical experiments, including public demos and credentialed full data.
trigger: After the authorized medical experiments finish and aggregate results have been verified and retained.
delete: Raw source files, download archives, and incomplete downloads
Patient-level processed tables, split exports, and predictions
Temporary files, dataset caches, and data backups created for these experiments
Patient-level demo tables in external/YAIB/demo_data for eicu_demo and mimic_demo
Any logs or other experiment artifacts containing patient records
additional_locations: Include alternate download roots (MEDICAL_DATA_ROOT) and any other copies created during the medical experiments; record these locations when used.
retain: Non-patient-level aggregate metrics and aggregate statistical summaries
A cleanup report listing removed paths and verification status, without patient records
completion_check: Check all recorded raw, processed, cache, temporary, backup, and external demo locations after deletion and report the outcome to the user.
public_shift_status: Readmission-only exploratory component development evaluated. Original780 remaining evaluation patients and preceding strong Base/Shared retained. Additional-target supervision and computation disclosed. All Sepsis results frozen; eICU/MIMIC copies remain deleted.
